guide.summary: To say how well, how fast, how early an action is done, Chinese puts the comment after the verb: Verb + 得 + (很) adjective. The idea that makes it click: 得 must touch the verb. An object, 了 or 不 can never sit between them, so the object is moved out of the way and 不 goes after 得. The same 得 after an adjective adds 'extremely': 热得很, 累得要命.

subs.label: Verb + 得 + 很 + adjective
subs.focus: No object. Learner must put 得 (not 的, 地, 了 or nothing) between verb and comment and keep it directly on the verb, also in past-time sentences. Classic mistakes: 他跑很快, 他很快跑, 他昨天来了得很晚. Keep a degree word (很, 非常, 真, 不太) before the adjective.

subs.label: Object present: repeat the verb
subs.focus: Sentence has an object or a verb-object word (游泳, 睡觉, 唱歌, 跳舞, 做饭, 开车). Learner must repeat the verb before 得: 说中文说得很好, 游泳游得很快. Classic mistake: 得 after the object (他说中文得很好, 他游泳得很快). Tile the two verbs separately, or blank the second verb.

subs.label: Object present: move it before the verb
subs.focus: Learner must put the object before the verb: 他中文说得很好, 这个菜你做得很好吃. Classic mistakes: 他说得很好中文, 他说得中文很好. Order items need alts: 他中文说得很好, 中文他说得很好 and 他说中文说得很好 are all correct, so cut tiles to limit what can be built.

subs.label: 不 goes after 得
subs.focus: The learner must put the negative on the comment: 说得不好, 睡得不太好. Classic mistakes: 不 before the verb (他不说得好), and 没 for past time (我昨天没睡得好). Include softened forms 不太 and 不怎么. Do not use sentences where a negated verb plus a different structure would also be natural.

subs.label: Asking: 得怎么样, 得好不好, 得…吗
subs.focus: The learner must build the question on the part after 得: 考得怎么样, 说得好不好, 睡得好吗. Classic mistakes: A-not-A on the verb (他说不说得好), 吗 added to a 怎么样 or A-not-A question, and 很 kept inside A-not-A (说得很好不好). Also drill short answers: 说得很好 / 说得不太好.

subs.label: Adjective + 得 + 很 / 不得了 / 要命
subs.focus: Intensifier after an adjective or feeling verb: 热得很, 高兴得不得了, 累得要命. Learner must keep 得, add no 很 in front, and know 极了 and 死了 take no 得. Classic mistakes: 很热得很, 累要命, 好得极了. Use 要命 only for unpleasant things; never test 要命 against 不得了.

subs.label: 得 after the verb or 地 before it
subs.focus: Verb + 得 + adjective versus adjective + 地 + Verb; blank position must decide. Classic mistakes: 地 or 的 after the verb (他跑地很快, 他说的很好) and 地 for a judgment of skill, result or timing (他很好地说中文, 他很早地来了). Never use tiles where both a 地 and a 得 sentence are natural.

subs.label: 很 + adjective or Verb + 得 + adjective
subs.focus: Does the adjective describe the person or thing (他很高, 他的中文很好) or how an action goes (他跑得很快, 他中文说得很好)? Classic mistakes: English-style 他很好说中文, 她很漂亮写字, or dropping the verb (他中文得很好). Do not mark topic-comment 他跑步很快 as wrong: it is acceptable.

rules.rule: To comment on how an action is done, say the verb, then 得, then a degree word and the adjective. The comment comes after the verb, never before it.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 + 很 / 非常 / 真 / 太 + Adjective

examples.py: tā pǎo de hěn kuài
tā chàng de fēi cháng hǎo
nǐ lái de tài zǎo le

rules.note: 很 here is usually just a filler, not a strong 'very'. A bare adjective (他跑得快) is possible but sounds like a comparison or an answer to a question, and out of context it can also be read as 'he is able to run fast', so use a degree word in plain statements.

rules.rule: 得 sticks to the verb. Do not put 了 between them, even when the action is in the past or already finished; a time word is enough.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de hěn wǎn
examples.en: I went to sleep very late yesterday.

examples.py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
wǒ men zuó tiān wán de hěn gāo xìng
examples.en: We had a great time yesterday.

rules.note: The 了 in 太…了 (来得太早了) belongs to 太 and sits at the end of the sentence; that one is fine.

rules.rule: If the verb has an object, 得 cannot follow the object. Say verb + object first, then say the verb again and add 得. Verb-object words such as 游泳, 睡觉, 唱歌, 跳舞, 做饭 and 开车 work the same way: repeat only the first character.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Object + Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.py: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo
tā xiě hàn zì xiě de hěn piào liang
wǒ dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
examples.en: I went to bed very late yesterday.

rules.note: You can also just drop the object part of a verb-object word when it adds nothing: 他游得很快, 我睡得很晚.

rules.rule: Instead of repeating the verb, you can put the object before the verb, right after the subject or at the very start of the sentence. Nothing follows the adjective.
rules.pattern: Subject + Object + Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.py: tā zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo
zhè ge cài nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo chī
examples.en: You cooked this dish really well.

examples.py: zuò yè tā xiě de hěn rèn zhēn

rules.note: A third common version uses 的: 他的中文说得很好, 她的字写得很漂亮. All of these mean the same as the verb-copy sentence.

rules.rule: To say something is not done well, negate the adjective after 得 with 不. Never put 不 or 没 in front of the verb, whatever the time.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 + 不 / 不太 + Adjective

examples.py: tā shuō de bù hǎo
wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo
examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

examples.py: tā kāi chē kāi de bù tài kuài

rules.note: Do not confuse this with the result complement, where 没 does go before the verb and there is no 得: 我昨天没睡好.

rules.rule: Ask about the part after 得: use 怎么样 for an open question, adjective + 不 + adjective or 吗 for yes or no. 怎么样 and A-not-A questions take no 吗, and A-not-A takes no 很.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 + 怎么样 / Adjective + 不 + Adjective

examples.py: nǐ kǎo de zěn me yàng
tā zhōng wén shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
nǐ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de hǎo ma
examples.en: Did you sleep well last night?

rules.rule: Adjective + 得很 means 'really, very'. It is stronger than 很 + adjective, and you cannot use both at once.

examples.py: jīn tiān rè de hěn
nà r de dōng xi guì de hěn
tā zuì jìn máng de hěn
examples.en: He has been really busy lately.

rules.rule: For 'extremely', add 得不得了 or 得要命 after an adjective or a feeling verb. 得 is required and there is no 很 in front.
rules.pattern: Subject + Adjective + 得 + 不得了 / 要命

examples.py: tā gāo xìng de bù dé liǎo
wǒ jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng
wài miàn lěng de yào mìng

rules.note: 要命 is mostly used for unpleasant things (累, 冷, 疼, 忙), though people do say 喜欢得要命; 不得了 fits good and bad alike. 极了 and 死了 mean much the same but attach directly, with no 得: 好极了, 累死了.

rules.rule: Position decides the particle. A describing word before the verb is linked with 地 and tells the manner in which someone does something; a comment after the verb is linked with 得.
rules.pattern: Adjective + 地 + Verb / Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.py: tā gāo xìng de xiào le
tā xiào de hěn gāo xìng
tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī shuō huà
examples.en: She listens carefully to the teacher.

rules.note: Both are pronounced de, so this is a writing choice. In casual writing native speakers often type 的 for either one; in this app only 得 after the verb and 地 before it are accepted.

rules.rule: When you are judging skill, result, speed or timing (well, badly, fast, early, late, clearly), use Verb + 得. These adjectives do not go before the verb with 地.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 + 很 + 好 / 快 / 早 / 晚 / 清楚

examples.py: tā jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu
tā tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo

rules.note: 很快 before a verb does exist, but it means 'soon, before long' (他很快就回来了), not 'at high speed'.

rules.rule: 很 + adjective alone describes what a person or thing is like. When the English says someone does something well, fast or badly, the verb must be there and the adjective goes after 得.
rules.pattern: Subject + 很 + Adjective / Subject + Verb + 得 + 很 + Adjective

examples.py: tā hěn gāo pǎo de yě hěn kuài
examples.en: He is tall and he also runs fast.

examples.py: tā de zhōng wén hěn hǎo
tā zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo

examples.zh: 我妈妈做饭做得很好吃。
examples.py: wǒ mā ma zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo chī
examples.en: My mum is a very good cook.

rules.note: Chinese also allows an activity as the topic followed by 很 + adjective: 他跑步很快, 她做饭很好吃. That is correct too. What is never possible is adjective first and verb after it, as in English 'good at speaking': 他很好说中文.

right.py: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: 得 must follow a verb, not an object. Repeat 说 after 中文, or move 中文 in front: 他中文说得很好.

right.py: wǒ dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài

contrasts.why: 游泳 is verb 游 plus object 泳, so 得 after it is 得 after an object. Repeat 游, or just say 游得很快.
He does speak; what is negated is 'well'. 不 goes after 得, on the adjective.

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo
right.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

contrasts.why: Past time does not change the rule: still 不 after 得. 没 before the verb only works without 得, as a result complement: 没睡好.

right.py: tā zuó tiān lái de hěn wǎn

contrasts.why: Nothing can stand between the verb and 得, not even 了. 昨天 already shows it is past.
A verb cannot be followed directly by 很 + adjective. The link 得 is required.

right.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo

contrasts.why: 'Well' is a judgment of how the singing turns out, so it goes after the verb with 得. 很好地 before the verb is not how Chinese says 'does something well'.

right.py: nǐ kǎo de zěn me yàng

contrasts.why: 怎么样 already makes it a question. 吗 is only for yes or no questions such as 你考得好吗？
得很 already gives the degree, so the adjective takes no 很 in front. Choose 很热 or 热得很.

right.py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng

contrasts.why: 要命 and 不得了 need 得 to attach to the adjective. Only 极了 and 死了 attach directly: 累死了.

cheat: How well, how fast, how early? Verb + 得 + 很 + adjective, comment after the verb.
得 touches the verb: no object, no 了, no 不 in between.
Got an object, or a word like 游泳, 睡觉, 唱歌? Repeat the verb (说中文说得) or move the object forward (中文说得).
Negative: 不 after 得 (说得不好), also for the past. Never 不说得 or 没说得.
Question: 得怎么样？ 得好不好？ 得好吗？ No 吗 with the first two.
After the verb write 得; before the verb write 地. 'Well, fast, early, late' go after the verb.
热得很, 累得要命, 高兴得不得了: keep 得, drop the 很 in front. 极了 and 死了 take no 得.

items.q: 我昨天睡___很晚。
items.zh: 我昨天睡得很晚。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de hěn wǎn
items.en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
items.why: How late I slept is a comment on the verb, so 睡 + 得 + 很晚. 地 would put the manner before the verb, and 昨天 already shows past time.

items.q: 这次会议开___太长了，大家都累了。
items.zh: 这次会议开得太长了，大家都累了。
items.py: zhè cì huì yì kāi de tài cháng le dà jiā dōu lèi le
items.en: The meeting ran too long, and everyone was tired.
items.why: Verb + 得 + 太 + adjective evaluates how the meeting went. 开了太长 is not Chinese; 了 cannot replace the link 得.

items.q: 医生说___很慢，我听懂了。
items.zh: 医生说得很慢，我听懂了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō de hěn màn wǒ tīng dǒng le
items.en: The doctor spoke very slowly, and I understood.
items.why: 说 + 得 + 很慢 describes the manner of speaking after the verb. 说了很慢 is ungrammatical, and 地 would have to come before 说.

items.q: 你昨天走___太早了，没看到经理。
items.zh: 你昨天走得太早了，没看到经理。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān zǒu de tài zǎo le méi kàn dào jīng lǐ
items.en: You left too early yesterday and missed the manager.
items.why: Judging timing takes 走得太早了: 得 right after the verb, with the 了 at the end belonging to 太. 走了太早 is not possible.

items.q: 文件传___特别慢，我等了十分钟。
items.zh: 文件传得特别慢，我等了十分钟。
items.py: wén jiàn chuán de tè bié màn wǒ děng le shí fēn zhōng
items.en: The file transferred really slowly; I waited ten minutes.
items.why: The speed of the transfer is a comment after the verb: 传得特别慢. 传了特别慢 does not exist, and 地 goes before verbs.

items.q: 她从楼梯上摔下来，摔___很重，膝盖肿了。
items.zh: 她从楼梯上摔下来，摔得很重，膝盖肿了。
items.py: tā cóng lóu tī shàng shuāi xià lái shuāi de hěn zhòng xī gài zhǒng le
items.en: She fell down the stairs, and fell hard; her knee swelled up.
items.why: How hard she fell is a comment on 摔, so 摔得很重. 了 cannot be followed by 很重 in this meaning.

items.q: 我弟弟写字写___很难看。
items.zh: 我弟弟写字写得很难看。
items.py: wǒ dì di xiě zì xiě de hěn nán kàn
items.en: My little brother's handwriting is really ugly.
items.why: 写字 has an object, so 写 is repeated and 得 follows the second 写. 地 would go before the verb, and 了 cannot link a comment.

items.q: 李医生看病___得很仔细。
items.zh: 李医生看病看得很仔细。
items.py: lǐ yī shēng kàn bìng kàn de hěn zǐ xì
items.en: Doctor Li examines patients very carefully.
items.why: The verb in 看病 must be repeated before 得: 看病看得很仔细. The other verbs do not repeat the verb of the object phrase.

items.q: 小王打字打___特别快，一分钟能打一百个字。
items.zh: 小王打字打得特别快，一分钟能打一百个字。
items.py: xiǎo wáng dǎ zì dǎ de tè bié kuài yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
items.en: Xiao Wang types really fast; he can type a hundred characters a minute.
items.why: After 打字, repeat 打 and add 得 for the comment 特别快. 得 cannot attach to the object 字.

items.q: 他睡觉睡___很香，叫了好几次都没醒。
items.zh: 他睡觉睡得很香，叫了好几次都没醒。
items.py: tā shuì jiào shuì de hěn xiāng jiào le hǎo jǐ cì dōu méi xǐng
items.en: He was sleeping soundly; I called him several times and he did not wake.
items.why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so the verb repeats and 得 links the comment 很香. 过 and 了 mark experience or completion, not a comment.

items.q: 她昨天加班加___太晚，今天一直在打哈欠。
items.zh: 她昨天加班加得太晚，今天一直在打哈欠。
items.py: tā zuó tiān jiā bān jiā de tài wǎn jīn tiān yī zhí zài dǎ hā qian
items.en: She worked overtime until very late yesterday and has been yawning all day.
items.why: 加班 has the object 班, so the verb repeats: 加班加得太晚. The 昨天 is enough to show it is past, so 了 is not squeezed between 加 and 得.

items.q: 他开车开___太快，我有点害怕。
items.zh: 他开车开得太快，我有点害怕。
items.py: tā kāi chē kāi de tài kuài wǒ yǒu diǎn hài pà
items.en: He drives too fast; I'm a bit scared.
items.why: After 开车 the verb is repeated: 开车开得太快. 开了太快 is not a possible comment on how he drives.

items.q: 她做饭___得很快，二十分钟就做好了三个菜。
items.zh: 她做饭做得很快，二十分钟就做好了三个菜。
items.py: tā zuò fàn zuò de hěn kuài èr shí fēn zhōng jiù zuò hǎo le sān gè cài
items.en: She cooks fast; she had three dishes ready in twenty minutes.
items.why: The repeated verb must be the same as the one in 做饭, and the clause that follows (做好了三个菜) confirms she is the cook. Other verbs would change the meaning.

items.q: 我爸爸打太极拳打___很标准，医生也夸他。
items.zh: 我爸爸打太极拳打得很标准，医生也夸他。
items.py: wǒ bà ba dǎ tài jí quán dǎ de hěn biāo zhǔn yī shēng yě kuā tā
items.en: My father does tai chi very correctly, and even the doctor praised him.
items.why: 打太极拳 has an object, so the verb 打 repeats and takes 得 before the comment 很标准. The comment cannot follow the object directly.

items.q: 这份报告他写___非常认真。
items.zh: 这份报告他写得非常认真。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào tā xiě de fēi cháng rèn zhēn
items.en: He wrote this report very carefully.
items.why: With the object fronted (这份报告), 得 follows the verb directly and nothing comes after the adjective. 地 belongs before the verb.

items.q: 英语他说___不错。
items.zh: 英语他说得不错。
items.py: yīng yǔ tā shuō de bù cuò
items.en: He speaks English quite well.
items.why: The topic 英语 is moved to the front, leaving 说 next to 得. 说地 and 说过 do not give an evaluation of how well he speaks.

items.q: 今天的饭你做___真好吃。
items.zh: 今天的饭你做得真好吃。
items.py: jīn tiān de fàn nǐ zuò de zhēn hǎo chī
items.en: The meal you cooked today turned out really tasty.
items.why: The object 今天的饭 is fronted, so 做得真好吃 works without repeating the verb. 做了真好吃 is not a possible comment.

items.q: 问题你回答___很清楚，我都听懂了。
items.zh: 问题你回答得很清楚，我都听懂了。
items.py: wèn tí nǐ huí dá de hěn qīng chu wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
items.en: You answered the question clearly; I understood it all.
items.why: With 问题 fronted, 回答 + 得 + 很清楚 judges how he answered. 回答了很清楚 is not a comment on manner.

items.q: 他的汉字写___很漂亮。
items.zh: 他的汉字写得很漂亮。
items.py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: He writes Chinese characters beautifully.
items.why: 得 must sit right after 写, with the object 他的汉字 in front. 地 goes before verbs, and 过 means past experience.

items.q: 昨天的会议记录小王整理___很详细，经理夸了他。
items.zh: 昨天的会议记录小王整理得很详细，经理夸了他。
items.py: zuó tiān de huì yì jì lù xiǎo wáng zhěng lǐ de hěn xiáng xì jīng lǐ kuā le tā
items.en: Xiao Wang put yesterday's meeting minutes in order in great detail, and the manager praised him.
items.why: The long object is fronted, so the verb 整理 takes 得 directly. 整理了很详细 would not describe how he did it.

items.q: 我昨天睡得___好，所以今天很累。
items.zh: 我昨天睡得不好，所以今天很累。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo suǒ yǐ jīn tiān hěn lèi
items.en: I didn't sleep well last night, so I'm tired today.
items.why: Negate the comment with 不 after 得, even for past time. 没 cannot follow 得, and 很好 would not explain why he is tired.

items.q: 他今天说话说得___太清楚，我听不懂。
items.zh: 他今天说话说得不太清楚，我听不懂。
items.py: tā jīn tiān shuō huà shuō de bù tài qīng chu wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He wasn't speaking very clearly today, and I couldn't understand.
items.why: 不太 softens the negation and sits after 得. 没太 does not occur there, and 很太 is not possible.

items.q: 我最近胃不舒服，吃得___多，只能喝粥。
items.zh: 我最近胃不舒服，吃得不多，只能喝粥。
items.py: wǒ zuì jìn wèi bù shū fu chī de bù duō zhǐ néng hē zhōu
items.en: My stomach is upset lately; I don't eat much, only congee.
items.why: 吃得不多: the negative goes on the adjective after 得. 吃得很多 contradicts 只能喝粥, and 没 is not used after 得.

items.q: 她开车开得___太快，我坐她的车很放心。
items.zh: 她开车开得不太快，我坐她的车很放心。
items.py: tā kāi chē kāi de bù tài kuài wǒ zuò tā de chē hěn fàng xīn
items.en: She doesn't drive too fast; I feel safe in her car.
items.why: 不太快 puts the negative after 得. 很太快 is ungrammatical and 没 is never used here.

items.q: 他昨天写得___多，只写了一页。
items.zh: 他昨天写得不多，只写了一页。
items.py: tā zuó tiān xiě de bù duō zhǐ xiě le yī yè
items.en: He didn't write much yesterday, just one page.
items.why: 写得不多 is the negated comment. 太多 or 很多 would contradict 只写了一页, and 没多 cannot follow 得.

items.q: 这次培训大家学得___怎么好，经理不太满意。
items.zh: 这次培训大家学得不怎么好，经理不太满意。
items.py: zhè cì péi xùn dà jiā xué de bù zěn me hǎo jīng lǐ bù tài mǎn yì
items.en: People didn't learn very well in this training, and the manager isn't very satisfied.
items.why: 不怎么 weakens the adjective and follows 得. 很怎么好 is not possible, and 没 does not go after 得.

items.q: 孩子发烧了，昨天晚上睡得___安稳。
items.zh: 孩子发烧了，昨天晚上睡得不安稳。
items.py: hái zi fā shāo le zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de bù ān wěn
items.en: The child had a fever and didn't sleep soundly last night.
items.why: The negative of the comment is 睡得不安稳, past time or not. 没安稳 is not used, and 很 would say the opposite of the English.

items.q: 经理今天讲得___快，所以我都记下来了。
items.zh: 经理今天讲得不快，所以我都记下来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān jiǎng de bù kuài suǒ yǐ wǒ dōu jì xià lái le
items.en: The manager didn't speak fast today, so I wrote everything down.
items.why: 讲得不快 negates the comment after 得. 太快 would make it impossible to write everything down, and 没快 is not Chinese.

items.q: 你昨晚睡得___？
items.zh: 你昨晚睡得怎么样？
items.py: nǐ zuó wǎn shuì de zěn me yàng
items.en: How did you sleep last night?
items.why: The question word 怎么样 stands after 得 and needs no 吗. Adding 吗 to 怎么样 or to an A-not-A question is a mistake.

items.q: 你觉得小李的英语说得好___好？
items.zh: 你觉得小李的英语说得好不好？
items.py: nǐ jué de xiǎo lǐ de yīng yǔ shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Do you think Xiao Li speaks English well?
items.why: The A-not-A question is built on the adjective after 得: 好不好. 没 is not used here, 吗 is for yes-no questions, and 很 does not go inside A-not-A.

items.q: 老师，这个字我写得___？
items.zh: 老师，这个字我写得好不好？
items.py: lǎo shī zhè gè zì wǒ xiě de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Teacher, did I write this character well?
items.why: A-not-A uses the bare adjective: 好不好. 很 cannot go inside it, and 吗 cannot be added to an A-not-A or 怎么样 question.

items.q: 你这次出差出得___？事情都办完了吗？
items.zh: 你这次出差出得怎么样？事情都办完了吗？
items.py: nǐ zhè cì chū chāi chū de zěn me yàng shì qing dōu bàn wán le ma
items.en: How did your business trip go? Did you finish everything?
items.why: 出差出得怎么样 asks how it went. 怎么样 is already a question word, so 吗 and 很 are wrong.

items.q: 他昨天加班加得很晚___？
items.zh: 他昨天加班加得很晚吗？
items.py: tā zuó tiān jiā bān jiā de hěn wǎn ma
items.en: Did he work overtime until very late yesterday?
items.why: The statement 加班加得很晚 becomes a yes-no question with 吗. The other endings need a bare adjective and no 很 before them.

items.q: 这位病人今天吃得多___多？
items.zh: 这位病人今天吃得多不多？
items.py: zhè wèi bìng rén jīn tiān chī de duō bù duō
items.en: Did this patient eat a lot today?
items.why: A-not-A on the adjective: 多不多. 没 is not used in this pattern, 吗 would make a different question, and 很 cannot sit inside it.

items.q: 今天办公室里热___很，我想开空调。
items.zh: 今天办公室里热得很，我想开空调。
items.py: jīn tiān bàn gōng shì lǐ rè de hěn wǒ xiǎng kāi kōng tiáo
items.en: It's really hot in the office today; I want to turn on the air conditioning.
items.why: Adjective + 得很 means very. 得 is required, and 地 belongs before verbs.

items.q: 我今天累___要命，想早点回家。
items.zh: 我今天累得要命，想早点回家。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā
items.en: I'm dead tired today and want to go home early.
items.why: 累得要命 needs 得 between the adjective and 要命. 累要命 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 他听到自己升职了，高兴___不得了。
items.zh: 他听到自己升职了，高兴得不得了。
items.py: tā tīng dào zì jǐ shēng zhí le gāo xìng de bù dé liǎo
items.en: He was overjoyed to hear he'd been promoted.
items.why: 高兴得不得了 is a fixed intensifier and needs 得. 地 would turn 高兴 into a manner word before a verb.

items.q: 这几天我牙疼___要命，什么都吃不了。
items.zh: 这几天我牙疼得要命，什么都吃不了。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān wǒ yá téng de yào mìng shén me dōu chī bù liǎo
items.en: My tooth has been killing me these days; I can't eat anything.
items.why: 疼得要命 is the intensifier for a bad feeling, and 得 cannot be dropped. 地 does not fit after a verb or adjective.

items.q: 这件事让他担心___要命。
items.zh: 这件事让他担心得要命。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì ràng tā dān xīn de yào mìng
items.en: This matter worries him to death.
items.why: 担心得要命: 得 links the feeling verb to 要命, which suits an unpleasant feeling. 担心地要命 is not possible.

items.q: 这个办法好___了，我们就用它吧。
items.zh: 这个办法好极了，我们就用它吧。
items.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ hǎo jí le wǒ men jiù yòng tā ba
items.en: This idea is excellent; let's use it.
items.why: 好极了 attaches 极了 directly with no 得. 得极 is a wrong blend, 要命 suits unpleasant things only, and 很了 is not Chinese.

items.q: 忙了一天，我累___了。
items.zh: 忙了一天，我累死了。
items.py: máng le yī tiān wǒ lèi sǐ le
items.en: After a whole day of work I'm exhausted.
items.why: 累死了 puts 死了 directly after the adjective, with no 得. Adding 得 or 很 breaks the fixed pattern.

items.q: 老板认真___听大家的意见。
items.zh: 老板认真地听大家的意见。
items.py: lǎo bǎn rèn zhēn de tīng dà jiā de yì jiàn
items.en: The boss listens carefully to everyone's opinions.
items.why: 认真 before the verb 听 describes the manner, so it takes 地. 得 only follows a verb and introduces a comment.

items.q: 她笑___很开心。
items.zh: 她笑得很开心。
items.py: tā xiào de hěn kāi xīn
items.en: She laughed very happily.
items.why: 很开心 comes after the verb as a comment on the laughing, so 笑得很开心. 地 would need the adjective in front of 笑.

items.q: 护士轻轻___把药放在桌子上。
items.zh: 护士轻轻地把药放在桌子上。
items.py: hù shi qīng qīng de bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The nurse gently put the medicine on the table.
items.why: 轻轻 comes before the verb phrase, so it is joined by 地. 得 would have to follow a verb.

items.q: 医生耐心___给病人解释药怎么吃。
items.zh: 医生耐心地给病人解释药怎么吃。
items.py: yī shēng nài xīn de gěi bìng rén jiě shì yào zěn me chī
items.en: The doctor patiently explains to the patient how to take the medicine.
items.why: 耐心 describes the manner and sits before 给病人解释, so 地 is needed. 得 cannot follow it because no verb precedes.

items.q: 大家都说他讲___很清楚。
items.zh: 大家都说他讲得很清楚。
items.py: dà jiā dōu shuō tā jiǎng de hěn qīng chu
items.en: Everyone says he explained it very clearly.
items.why: 很清楚 judges how he explained, so it follows the verb with 得. 地 would put the manner before 讲.

items.q: 他慢慢___站起来，说头还有点晕。
items.zh: 他慢慢地站起来，说头还有点晕。
items.py: tā màn màn de zhàn qǐ lái shuō tóu hái yǒu diǎn yūn
items.en: He slowly stood up and said his head was still a bit dizzy.
items.why: 慢慢 before the verb 站起来 takes 地. 得 is only used after a verb.

items.q: 他___高，跑得也很快。
items.zh: 他很高，跑得也很快。
items.py: tā hěn gāo pǎo de yě hěn kuài
items.en: He is tall, and he also runs fast.
items.why: 他很高 describes the person, so 很 + adjective. The second half, 跑得也很快, describes the action, which needs 得.

items.q: 王医生的字写___很难看，但是人很好。
items.zh: 王医生的字写得很难看，但是人很好。
items.py: wáng yī shēng de zì xiě de hěn nán kàn dàn shì rén hěn hǎo
items.en: Doctor Wang's handwriting is ugly, but he is a nice person.
items.why: The comment is on how the writing is done, so 写得很难看. 写很难看 lacks the link 得, and 地 goes before verbs.

items.q: 小李个子不高，但是篮球打___很好。
items.zh: 小李个子不高，但是篮球打得很好。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ gè zi bù gāo dàn shì lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
items.en: Xiao Li is not tall, but he plays basketball well.
items.why: How well he plays is a comment on 打, so 打得很好. 打很好 skips the link and 地 does not belong after a verb.

items.q: 爸爸的血压不太高，他走路走___很稳。
items.zh: 爸爸的血压不太高，他走路走得很稳。
items.py: bà ba de xuè yā bù tài gāo tā zǒu lù zǒu de hěn wěn
items.en: Dad's blood pressure is not too high, and he walks steadily.
items.why: 走路走得很稳 comments on how he walks, so 得 follows the repeated verb. 走路走很稳 has no link.

items.zh: 经理来得很早。
items.py: jīng lǐ lái de hěn zǎo
items.en: The manager came very early.
items.why: The comment 很早 follows 来 with 得 between them. 很早 cannot come before the verb to express how early he came, and 得 must touch 来.

items.zh: 她昨晚睡得不好。
items.py: tā zuó wǎn shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: She didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: The negative 不 belongs to the comment, after 得. 不 before 睡 would negate the sleeping itself.

items.zh: 她唱歌唱得非常好。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de fēi cháng hǎo
items.en: She sings extremely well.
items.why: 唱歌 has an object, so the verb 唱 repeats and takes 得. 得 cannot follow 歌.

items.zh: 这份报告他写得很认真。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào tā xiě de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: He wrote this report very carefully.
items.why: The object goes in front of the verb, either before or after the subject. 得 follows 写 directly and nothing comes after 很认真.

items.zh: 你昨天考得怎么样？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān kǎo de zěn me yàng
items.en: How did you do on the exam yesterday?
items.why: 怎么样 sits after 得 where the comment would be. The question word needs no 吗.

items.zh: 他今天累得要命。
items.py: tā jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng
items.en: He is dead tired today.
items.why: 累得要命 needs 得 between the adjective and 要命. 要命 cannot come before 累.

items.zh: 老师说话说得不太快。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō huà shuō de bù tài kuài
items.en: The teacher doesn't speak too fast.
items.why: 说话 has an object, so 说 repeats; the 不太 goes on the adjective after 得.

items.zh: 她走得很快。
items.py: tā zǒu de hěn kuài
items.en: She walks fast.
items.why: 走得很快: 得 sits between the verb and the comment. 很快 before 走 would mean 'soon'.

items.zh: 他认真地听老师讲。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng
items.en: He listens attentively as the teacher speaks.
items.why: 认真 describes how he listens and goes before 听 with 地. 得 would only follow the verb.

items.zh: 他昨天开会开得很晚。
items.py: tā zuó tiān kāi huì kāi de hěn wǎn
items.en: He was in the meeting until very late yesterday.
items.why: 开会 is verb + object, so 开 repeats before 得. 得 cannot attach to 会.

items.zh: 我每天睡得很早。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān shuì de hěn zǎo
items.en: I go to bed very early every day.
items.why: The time word may stand before or after the subject, but 得 and its comment stay directly after 睡.

items.zh: 你说中文说得好不好？
items.py: nǐ shuō zhōng wén shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Do you speak Chinese well?
items.why: A-not-A is built on the adjective after 得 (好不好), with the verb repeated after the object.

items.zh: 外面冷得很。
items.py: wài miàn lěng de hěn
items.en: It's really cold outside.
items.why: 得很 goes after the adjective: 冷得很. Putting 很 in front as well (很冷得很) doubles the degree word, and 得 must stay between 冷 and 很.

items.zh: 他的字写得很漂亮。
items.py: tā de zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: His handwriting is beautiful.
items.why: The object 他的字 is fronted, then 写得 + comment. 得 must be directly after 写.

items.zh: 昨晚我睡得不太踏实。
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì de bù tài tā shi
items.en: I did not sleep very soundly last night.
items.why: The negative 不太 goes after 得 on the comment. The time word can be before or after 我.

items.src_py: tā shuō yīng yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì
items.task: Move 英语 in front of the verb and drop the repeated verb.
items.zh: 她英语说得很流利。
items.py: tā yīng yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì
items.en: She speaks English very fluently.
items.why: With the object fronted the verb appears only once, directly before 得. The topic can be before or after 她.

items.src_py: lǎo lǐ zuó wǎn shuì de hěn hǎo
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 老李昨晚睡得不好。
items.py: lǎo lǐ zuó wǎn shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: Lao Li didn't sleep well last night.
items.why: Negate the comment with 不 after 得. 不睡得好 and 没睡得好 are wrong.

items.src_py: dì di zuò yè xiě de hěn kuài
items.task: Repeat the verb instead of fronting the object.
items.zh: 弟弟写作业写得很快。
items.py: dì di xiě zuò yè xiě de hěn kuài
items.en: My little brother does his homework fast.
items.why: Keep the object after the first verb and repeat 写 before 得. 得 cannot follow 作业.

items.src_py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
items.task: Turn it into a yes-no question with 吗.
items.zh: 小李今天来得很早吗？
items.py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo ma
items.en: Did Xiao Li come very early today?
items.why: A statement becomes a yes-no question when 吗 is added at the end. 来得 stays together.

items.src_py: jīng lǐ shuō de hěn qīng chu
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.zh: 经理说得清楚不清楚？
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō de qīng chu bù qīng chu
items.en: Did the manager explain it clearly?
items.why: A-not-A repeats the adjective after 得 and drops 很. No 吗 is added.

items.src_py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān hěn lèi
items.task: Say he is extremely tired, with 得 and 要命.
items.zh: 小王今天累得要命。
items.py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng
items.en: Xiao Wang is dead tired today.
items.why: Replace 很累 with 累得要命. 很 is dropped, because 得 + 要命 carries the degree.

items.src_py: tā gāo xìng de xiào le
items.task: Say how he smiled using 得: he smiled very happily.
items.zh: 他笑得很高兴。
items.py: tā xiào de hěn gāo xìng
items.en: He smiled very happily.
items.why: Moving the adjective after the verb turns 地 into 得, and a degree word 很 is added.

items.src_py: tā xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.task: Use 她的字 as the topic.
items.zh: 她的字写得很漂亮。
items.py: tā de zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: Her handwriting is beautiful.
items.why: Fronting the object 她的字 removes the need to repeat 写.

items.src_py: tā pǎo de hěn kuài
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他跑得不快。
items.py: tā pǎo de bù kuài
items.en: He doesn't run fast.
items.why: Replace 很 with 不 after 得. 不 before 跑 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān shuì de hěn hǎo
items.task: Ask how he slept, with 怎么样.
items.zh: 他昨天睡得怎么样？
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuì de zěn me yàng
items.en: How did he sleep yesterday?
items.why: 怎么样 replaces 很好 after 得, and 吗 is not added.

items.s_py: tā shuō zhōng wén de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他说中文说得很好。
items.py: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo
items.en: He speaks Chinese well.
items.why: 得 cannot follow the object 中文. Repeat the verb: 说中文说得很好.

items.s: 昨天我加班到很晚，睡得不太好。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǒ jiā bān dào hěn wǎn shuì de bù tài hǎo
items.zh: 昨天我加班到很晚，睡得不太好。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ jiā bān dào hěn wǎn shuì de bù tài hǎo
items.en: I worked overtime until very late yesterday and didn't sleep very well.
items.why: Correct: 不太 follows 得 even though the sentence is in the past. The first clause has 到, not a 得 complement.

items.s_py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī shuō huà
items.zh: 她认真地听老师说话。
items.py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng lǎo shī shuō huà
items.en: She listens carefully to the teacher.
items.why: 认真 stands before the verb as a manner word and needs 地. 得 can only follow a verb.

items.s_py: tā xiě zì xiě de hěn kuài
items.zh: 他写字写得很快。
items.py: tā xiě zì xiě de hěn kuài
items.en: He writes fast.
items.why: Correct: the object 字 forces the repeated verb, and 得 follows the second 写.

items.s_py: tā shuō de hěn hǎo bù hǎo
items.zh: 他说得好不好？
items.py: tā shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Does he speak well?
items.why: A-not-A uses the bare adjective: 好不好. 很 cannot go inside it.

items.s_py: jīn tiān hěn rè de hěn
items.zh: 今天热得很。
items.py: jīn tiān rè de hěn
items.en: It's really hot today.
items.why: 得很 already gives the degree, so 很 in front of the adjective is redundant. Say 热得很 or 很热.

items.s_py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi yào mìng
items.zh: 我今天累得要命。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng
items.en: I'm dead tired today.
items.why: 要命 attaches to an adjective through 得. Without 得 it is wrong.

items.s_py: zhè gè bàn fǎ hěn hǎo jí le
items.zh: 这个办法好极了。
items.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ hǎo jí le
items.en: This idea is excellent.
items.why: 极了 already gives the degree and attaches directly to the adjective, so 很 in front is wrong. Say 好极了 (or 很好), never both.

items.s_py: nǐ jīn tiān lái de tài wǎn le
items.zh: 你今天来得太晚了。
items.py: nǐ jīn tiān lái de tài wǎn le
items.en: You came too late today.
items.why: Correct: the 了 at the end belongs to 太…了, not to the verb, so it does not break the link between 来 and 得.

items.s: 他的英语很好，说得也很流利。
items.s_py: tā de yīng yǔ hěn hǎo shuō de yě hěn liú lì
items.zh: 他的英语很好，说得也很流利。
items.py: tā de yīng yǔ hěn hǎo shuō de yě hěn liú lì
items.en: His English is good, and he speaks it fluently too.
items.why: Correct: 很好 describes his English, while 说得也很流利 evaluates the action. The two patterns are different and both right.

items.s_py: tā hěn piào liang xiě zì
items.zh: 她写字写得很漂亮。
items.py: tā xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
items.en: She writes beautifully.
items.why: The adjective cannot precede the verb to evaluate the action. Use 写字写得很漂亮.

items.s_py: tā kāi chē de hěn màn
items.zh: 她开车开得很慢。
items.py: tā kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
items.en: She drives slowly.

items.en: He skis especially well in winter, and we all want to learn from him.
items.why: 滑雪 is verb + object, so 滑 comes back before 得: 滑雪滑得特别好. The other choices are not the verb that 得 describes, and 雪得 would attach 得 to a noun.

items.q: 我姐姐吃饭___得很慢，每次都是最后一个吃完。
items.zh: 我姐姐吃饭吃得很慢，每次都是最后一个吃完。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie chī fàn chī de hěn màn měi cì dōu shì zuì hòu yī gè chī wán
items.en: My older sister eats slowly, and she is always the last to finish.
items.why: With the object 饭 in the sentence, 得 must come after a second 吃: 吃饭吃得很慢. Putting 得 straight after 饭 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 这个周末的聚会，他喝酒___得有点多，所以我们送他回家了。
items.zh: 这个周末的聚会，他喝酒喝得有点多，所以我们送他回家了。
items.py: zhè gè zhōu mò de jù huì tā hē jiǔ hē de yǒu diǎn duō suǒ yǐ wǒ men sòng tā huí jiā le
items.en: At this weekend’s party he drank a bit too much, so we took him home.
items.why: 喝酒 has its own object, so 喝 is said again before 得: 喝酒喝得有点多. 了 cannot stand between the verb and 得, and 酒得 puts 得 after a noun.

items.q: 秋天爸爸骑车___得很快，我跟不上。
items.zh: 秋天爸爸骑车骑得很快，我跟不上。
items.py: qiū tiān bà ba qí chē qí de hěn kuài wǒ gēn bù shàng
items.en: In autumn my dad rides fast and I cannot keep up.
items.why: 骑车 = verb + object, so 骑 is repeated: 骑车骑得很快. Without the second 骑, 得 would follow the noun 车, which is wrong.

items.q: 今天的饭他___得很好吃，朋友们都夸他。
items.zh: 今天的饭他做得很好吃，朋友们都夸他。
items.py: jīn tiān de fàn tā zuò de hěn hǎo chī péng you men dōu kuā tā
items.en: He cooked today’s meal really well, and his friends all praised him.
items.why: The object 今天的饭 is already in front, so only the bare verb 做 stands before 得. 做饭 would repeat the object, and 吃 is not what he did.

items.q: 这辆车他___得特别稳，我们都很放心。
items.zh: 这辆车他开得特别稳，我们都很放心。
items.py: zhè liàng chē tā kāi de tè bié wěn wǒ men dōu hěn fàng xīn
items.en: He drives this car very steadily, so we feel safe with him.
items.why: With 车 moved to the front, one verb 开 is left before 得: 这辆车他开得特别稳. 开车 would say the object a second time and breaks the pattern.

items.q: 她的字___得很漂亮，朋友们都夸她。
items.zh: 她的字写得很漂亮，朋友们都夸她。
items.py: tā de zì xiě de hěn piào liang péng you men dōu kuā tā
items.en: She writes beautifully, and her friends all praise her.
items.why: The object 字 is fronted (她的字), leaving the bare verb 写 right before 得. 写字得 would put 得 after an object, the classic error.

items.q: 这首歌小李___得特别好听，大家都鼓掌了。
items.zh: 这首歌小李唱得特别好听，大家都鼓掌了。
items.py: zhè shǒu gē xiǎo lǐ chàng de tè bié hǎo tīng dà jiā dōu gǔ zhǎng le
items.en: Xiao Li sang this song really well, and everyone applauded.
items.why: 这首歌 is fronted as the object, so only the verb 唱 stands before 得. 唱歌 would repeat an object, and 听 is not what Xiao Li did.

items.q: 他___说得很流利，朋友们都很佩服他。
items.zh: 他中文说得很流利，朋友们都很佩服他。
items.py: tā zhōng wén shuō de hěn liú lì péng you men dōu hěn pèi fú tā
items.en: He speaks Chinese fluently, and his friends admire him.
items.why: Moving the object between subject and verb gives 他中文说得很流利. 中文的 makes it a possessive noun without a proper link, and 把 does not belong in this pattern.

items.q: 周末的聚会，菜她___得太咸了，大家都没吃多少。
items.zh: 周末的聚会，菜她做得太咸了，大家都没吃多少。
items.py: zhōu mò de jù huì cài tā zuò de tài xián le dà jiā dōu méi chī duō shǎo
items.en: At the weekend party she made the dishes too salty, so people ate very little.
items.why: 菜 is fronted, so a single verb 做 sits before 得. Repeating 做菜 would double the object, and 吃 is not the action being judged.

items.q: 春游的照片她___得特别好，朋友们都想让她多拍几张。
items.zh: 春游的照片她拍得特别好，朋友们都想让她多拍几张。
items.py: chūn yóu de zhào piàn tā pāi de tè bié hǎo péng you men dōu xiǎng ràng tā duō pāi jǐ zhāng
items.en: She took the spring-outing photos especially well, and her friends want her to take more.
items.why: The object 春游的照片 is fronted, so the verb 拍 comes straight before 得. 拍照 would add an object again, which can never precede 得.

items.q: 他唱歌唱得___好，朋友们不想听。
items.zh: 他唱歌唱得不好，朋友们不想听。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo péng you men bù xiǎng tīng
items.en: He doesn’t sing well, and his friends don’t want to listen.
items.why: Negate the comment after 得: 唱得不好. 没 negates a past event, not a quality here, and the other choices are not negatives for an adjective.

items.q: 昨晚太吵了，我睡___太好。
items.zh: 昨晚太吵了，我睡得不太好。
items.py: zuó wǎn tài chǎo le wǒ shuì de bù tài hǎo
items.en: It was too noisy last night, and I did not sleep very well.
items.why: 不 goes after 得, on the adjective: 睡得不太好. 不得 or 没得 put the negative between verb and 得, where nothing can stand.

items.q: 他今天骑车骑得___快，因为风很大。
items.zh: 他今天骑车骑得不快，因为风很大。
items.py: tā jīn tiān qí chē qí de bù kuài yīn wèi fēng hěn dà
items.en: He didn’t ride fast today because of the strong wind.
items.why: The adjective after 得 is negated with 不: 骑得不快. 没 would point to a past event and cannot negate 快 in this pattern.

items.q: 周末下雨，我们玩得___太开心。
items.zh: 周末下雨，我们玩得不太开心。
items.py: zhōu mò xià yǔ wǒ men wán de bù tài kāi xīn
items.en: It rained at the weekend, so we did not have a very good time.
items.why: To say the comment is not true, put 不 right after 得: 玩得不太开心, even though the time is past. 很 cannot stack in front of 太, and 非 and 别 do not negate an adjective.

items.q: 昨晚太热，我睡得___怎么好。
items.zh: 昨晚太热，我睡得不怎么好。
items.py: zuó wǎn tài rè wǒ shuì de bù zěn me hǎo
items.en: It was too hot last night and I did not sleep very well.
items.why: 不怎么 softens a negative comment and follows 得: 睡得不怎么好. 很怎么 is not a phrase, and 没 does not combine with 怎么 here.

items.q: 春天的天气变化大，我们爬山爬得___太顺利，下午还下雨了。
items.zh: 春天的天气变化大，我们爬山爬得不太顺利，下午还下雨了。
items.py: chūn tiān de tiān qì biàn huà dà wǒ men pá shān pá de bù tài shùn lì xià wǔ hái xià yǔ le
items.en: The spring weather changes a lot, so our climb did not go very smoothly, and in the afternoon it rained.
items.why: Negation sits after 得, in front of 太顺利: 爬得不太顺利. 未 is a written-style negative, 别 is only for commands, and 很 cannot stand in front of 太.

items.q: 他昨天喝得___多，所以今天没事。
items.zh: 他昨天喝得不多，所以今天没事。
items.py: tā zuó tiān hē de bù duō suǒ yǐ jīn tiān méi shì
items.en: He did not drink much yesterday, so he is fine today.
items.why: Use 不 after 得 for a comment that does not hold: 喝得不多. 没 or 没有 would negate the drinking itself, which is not the idea.

items.q: 夏天我们游泳游得___好，所以不敢去深水。
items.zh: 夏天我们游泳游得不好，所以不敢去深水。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ men yóu yǒng yóu de bù hǎo suǒ yǐ bù gǎn qù shēn shuǐ
items.en: We do not swim well, so in summer we do not dare to go into deep water.
items.why: The adjective is negated: 游得不好. 不是 must be followed by a noun phrase, not a bare adjective, so it does not fit here.

items.q: 那几天天气不好，大家玩得___怎么开心。
items.zh: 那几天天气不好，大家玩得不怎么开心。
items.py: nà jǐ tiān tiān qì bù hǎo dà jiā wán de bù zěn me kāi xīn
items.en: The weather was bad those days, so nobody had a very good time.
items.why: 不怎么 goes after 得 and before the adjective: 玩得不怎么开心. 未 is written style, 别 is only for commands, and 很怎么 is not a phrase.

items.q: 周末的聚会你玩得___？
items.zh: 周末的聚会你玩得怎么样？
items.py: zhōu mò de jù huì nǐ wán de zěn me yàng
items.en: How was the party this weekend for you?
items.why: 怎么样 asks about the part after 得 and is already a question word, so 吗 must not follow it. 很怎么样 and a bare 怎么 do not form a question here.

items.q: 他中文说得___不___？
items.zh: 他中文说得好不好？
items.py: tā zhōng wén shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Does he speak Chinese well?
items.why: The A-not-A question repeats the bare adjective: 好不好. 很 cannot stay inside an A-not-A, and the adjective must be identical on both sides.

items.q: 这次春游你们玩___怎么样？
items.zh: 这次春游你们玩得怎么样？
items.py: zhè cì chūn yóu nǐ men wán de zěn me yàng
items.en: How was the spring outing for you all?
items.why: Ask about the comment after the verb: 玩得怎么样. 地 would modify a following verb, and 着 or 过 cannot link a verb to 怎么样.

items.q: 春游那天，你们起得早___早？
items.zh: 春游那天，你们起得早不早？
items.py: chūn yóu nà tiān nǐ men qǐ de zǎo bù zǎo
items.en: Did you get up early on the day of the outing?
items.why: A-not-A asks about the adjective after 得: 早不早. 吗 and 很 cannot be used inside it, and 没 does not form an A-not-A on a bare adjective.

items.q: 这次考试你考得___吗？
items.zh: 这次考试你考得好吗？
items.py: zhè cì kǎo shì nǐ kǎo de hǎo ma
items.en: Did you do well on this exam?
items.why: 吗 needs a plain statement: 考得好吗. 怎么样 and 好不好 are already questions, and 很好不好 is wrong twice over.

items.q: 你觉得这次春游安排得___？
items.zh: 你觉得这次春游安排得怎么样？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè cì chūn yóu ān pái de zěn me yàng
items.en: How do you think this spring outing was organised?
items.why: To ask for an opinion about the outing, put 怎么样 after 得 with nothing after it. 吗 cannot be added to a question word.

items.q: 你们昨天玩得开心___？
items.zh: 你们昨天玩得开心吗？
items.py: nǐ men zuó tiān wán de kāi xīn ma
items.en: Did you have fun yesterday?
items.why: 玩得开心 is a statement and 吗 turns it into a yes/no question. 怎么样, 什么 and 几 would be a second question word with 开心 already given.

items.q: 夏天的中午热___很，我不想出去。
items.zh: 夏天的中午热得很，我不想出去。
items.py: xià tiān de zhōng wǔ rè de hěn wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù
items.en: It is really hot at noon in summer, and I do not want to go out.
items.why: 热得很 needs 得 to link the adjective to 很. 地 only goes before verbs, and 了 or 着 cannot give the intensifying meaning here.

items.q: 今天冷___要命，我们别去爬山了。
items.zh: 今天冷得要命，我们别去爬山了。
items.py: jīn tiān lěng de yào mìng wǒ men bié qù pá shān le
items.en: It is freezing today, so let us not go hiking.
items.why: 要命 needs 得 after the adjective: 冷得要命. 了 would make it a change of state without the meaning of extreme degree, and 地 only goes before verbs.

items.q: 我今天累___，不想出去玩了。
items.zh: 我今天累死了，不想出去玩了。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi sǐ le bù xiǎng chū qù wán le
items.en: I am dead tired today and no longer want to go out.
items.why: 死了 attaches directly to the adjective: 累死了. 得 is not used before 死了, and 很 plus 死了 is never said.

items.q: 听说他们要来，我高兴___不得了。
items.zh: 听说他们要来，我高兴得不得了。
items.py: tīng shuō tā men yào lái wǒ gāo xīng de bù dé liǎo
items.en: When I heard they were coming, I was overjoyed.
items.why: 不得了 follows an adjective with 得: 高兴得不得了. 死 cannot join 不得了, and 地 or 了 would not link the adjective to the degree.

items.q: 今天___热得很，我们在家吃西瓜吧。
items.zh: 今天热得很，我们在家吃西瓜吧。
items.py: jīn tiān rè de hěn wǒ men zài jiā chī xī guā ba
items.en: It is really hot today, so let us eat watermelon at home.
items.why: 热得很 already means very hot, so no degree word goes before the adjective. 很热得很 or 真热得很 doubles the intensifier.

items.q: 春天了，可是山上还是冷___，大家都穿着厚外套。
items.zh: 春天了，可是山上还是冷得很，大家都穿着厚外套。
items.py: chūn tiān le kě shì shān shàng hái shì lěng de hěn dà jiā dōu chuān zhe hòu wài tào
items.en: It is spring, but it is still very cold on the mountain, and everyone is wearing a thick coat.
items.why: Adjective + 得很 gives strong degree. 冷很 lacks the 得, and 冷极 needs 了 and no 得. A bare 冷得 is incomplete.

items.q: 那个周末的聚会热闹___，大家都玩到很晚。
items.zh: 那个周末的聚会热闹极了，大家都玩到很晚。
items.py: nà gè zhōu mò de jù huì rè nao jí le dà jiā dōu wán dào hěn wǎn
items.en: That weekend’s party was extremely lively, and everyone played until late.
items.why: 极了 attaches to the adjective directly: 热闹极了. 得极了 and 极得 are not Chinese, and 很 cannot stack with 极了.

items.q: 朋友们都说那家店的菜好吃___，周末我们打算一起去尝尝。
items.zh: 朋友们都说那家店的菜好吃得很，周末我们打算一起去尝尝。
items.py: péng you men dōu shuō nà jiā diàn de cài hǎo chī de hěn zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn yī qǐ qù cháng cháng
items.en: My friends all say the food at that restaurant is really delicious, so we plan to try it together this weekend.
items.why: 好吃得很 is adjective + 得 + 很. 好吃很 drops 得, and 极得 reverses the fixed pattern 极了, which takes no 得.

items.q: 他高兴___对我说：“周末见！”
items.zh: 他高兴地对我说：“周末见！”
items.py: tā gāo xīng de duì wǒ shuō zhōu mò jiàn
items.en: He said to me happily, “See you at the weekend!”
items.why: 高兴 describes how he spoke and stands before the verb 说, so it takes 地. 得 would need a verb right in front of it, and 了 or 着 are not manner markers.

items.q: 朋友们笑___很开心。
items.zh: 朋友们笑得很开心。
items.py: péng you men xiào de hěn kāi xīn
items.en: My friends laughed with great joy.
items.why: 笑 is followed by a comment on how they laughed, so 笑得很开心. 地 goes before a verb, and 了 or 着 do not introduce a comment.

items.q: 孩子们开心___在雪地里跑来跑去。
items.zh: 孩子们开心地在雪地里跑来跑去。
items.py: hái zi men kāi xīn de zài xuě dì lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù
items.en: The children happily ran around in the snow.
items.why: 开心 modifies the action 跑来跑去 and comes before it, so use 地. 得 belongs after a verb, and 过 or 着 cannot link an adjective to a verb.

items.q: 他今天起___那么早，是想先去买下午聚会用的东西。
items.zh: 他今天起得那么早，是想先去买下午聚会用的东西。
items.py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de nà me zǎo shì xiǎng xiān qù mǎi xià wǔ jù huì yòng de dōng xi
items.en: He got up that early today because he wanted to buy things for the afternoon party first.
items.why: Timing after the verb is a comment, so 起得那么早. 地 would put an adjective before a verb, which does not describe how early.

items.q: 我朋友很聪明，学___也很快。
items.zh: 我朋友很聪明，学得也很快。
items.py: wǒ péng you hěn cōng ming xué de yě hěn kuài
items.en: My friend is very clever and learns fast too.
items.why: 很聪明 describes him; how he learns needs the verb with 得: 学得也很快. 地 before the verb or 了 cannot give this meaning.

items.q: 她的歌___很好听，大家都爱听。
items.zh: 她的歌唱得很好听，大家都爱听。
items.py: tā de gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng dà jiā dōu ài tīng
items.en: Her singing sounds very good, and everyone loves to listen.
items.why: To say the singing sounds good, the verb 唱 must carry 得: 她的歌唱得很好听. 唱很好听 lacks the link, and 很 or 好 alone is not a sentence.

items.q: 昨天的雪下___很大，路上没有人。
items.zh: 昨天的雪下得很大，路上没有人。
items.py: zuó tiān de xuě xià de hěn dà lù shàng méi yǒu rén
items.en: The snow was heavy yesterday, and there was nobody on the road.
items.why: How heavy the snow fell is a comment on 下, so 下得很大. 了 cannot sit between the verb and its comment, and 地 would go before a verb.

items.q: 春天的花开___很早，今年二月就开了。
items.zh: 春天的花开得很早，今年二月就开了。
items.py: chūn tiān de huā kāi de hěn zǎo jīn nián èr yuè jiù kāi le
items.en: The spring flowers bloomed very early; they were already out in February this year.
items.why: The timing of the blooming is a comment, so 开得很早. 地 modifies a following verb, and 着 or 过 cannot take such a comment.

items.q: 朋友们昨天到___太早了，我还没起床。
items.zh: 朋友们昨天到得太早了，我还没起床。
items.py: péng you men zuó tiān dào de tài zǎo le wǒ hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.en: My friends arrived too early yesterday and I was not even up yet.
items.why: 到得太早了 evaluates how early they arrived: verb + 得 + 太 + adjective, with 了 at the end. 着 and 过 cannot link a verb to such a comment.

items.q: 这个冬天过___特别快，转眼就是春天了。
items.zh: 这个冬天过得特别快，转眼就是春天了。
items.py: zhè gè dōng tiān guò de tè bié kuài zhuǎn yǎn jiù shì chūn tiān le
items.en: This winter went by especially fast, and spring is suddenly here.
items.why: How fast the winter passed is a comment, so 过得特别快. 了 may not come between 过 and the comment, and 地 goes before a verb.

items.q: 雨下___越来越大，我们只好取消了周末的野餐。
items.zh: 雨下得越来越大，我们只好取消了周末的野餐。
items.py: yǔ xià de yuè lái yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo qǔ xiāo le zhōu mò de yě cān
items.en: The rain kept getting heavier, so we had to cancel the weekend picnic.
items.why: The rain’s intensity is a comment after 下, so 下得越来越大. 着 and 了 cannot sit between a verb and a comment, and 地 goes before a verb.

items.q: 小李昨天走___很慢，因为路很滑。
items.zh: 小李昨天走得很慢，因为路很滑。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ zuó tiān zǒu de hěn màn yīn wèi lù hěn huá
items.en: Xiao Li walked slowly yesterday because the road was slippery.
items.why: How slowly he walked is a comment on 走, so 走得很慢. 地 cannot follow a verb and 了 cannot link a verb to a comment.

items.zh: 夏天我弟弟游泳游得很快。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
items.en: In summer my little brother swims fast.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 游 is repeated before 得. The time word may sit before or after the subject, but 得 must touch the second 游.

items.zh: 我朋友中文说得很流利。
items.py: wǒ péng you zhōng wén shuō de hěn liú lì
items.en: My friend speaks Chinese fluently.
items.why: The object 中文 moves before the verb, leaving 说 right before 得. A fronted object may also start the sentence, but nothing may follow the adjective.

items.zh: 昨晚我睡得不好。
items.py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: I did not sleep well last night.
items.why: 不 goes after 得 in front of the adjective: 睡得不好. 昨晚 may go before or after the subject.

items.zh: 你们春游玩得怎么样？
items.py: nǐ men chūn yóu wán de zěn me yàng
items.en: How was the spring outing for you all?
items.why: Ask about the comment with 怎么样 after 得. 春游 can come before or after 你们 as the topic, and 怎么样 has no 吗.

items.zh: 今天冷得要命。
items.py: jīn tiān lěng de yào mìng
items.en: It is freezing today.
items.why: 要命 follows an adjective through 得: 冷得要命. Putting 得 after 要命 or leaving it out breaks the pattern.

items.zh: 孩子们开心地在雪地里玩。
items.py: hái zi men kāi xīn de zài xuě dì lǐ wán
items.en: The children play happily in the snow.
items.why: 开心地 describes the manner of playing, so it stands before the verb. After 玩 it would need 得 and a comment instead.

items.zh: 下雪天爸爸开车开得特别小心。
items.py: xià xuě tiān bà ba kāi chē kāi de tè bié xiǎo xīn
items.en: On snowy days Dad drives very carefully.
items.why: 开车 is verb + object, so 开 is said again before 得: 开车开得特别小心. The time phrase can be before or after the subject.

items.zh: 这些照片她拍得特别好，大家都想看。
items.py: zhè xiē zhào piàn tā pāi de tè bié hǎo dà jiā dōu xiǎng kàn
items.en: She took these photos especially well, and everyone wants to see them.
items.why: The object 这些照片 is fronted, so 拍 stands right before 得. Either the object or the subject can come first.

items.zh: 昨天天气不好，我们玩得不太开心。
items.py: zuó tiān tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men wán de bù tài kāi xīn
items.en: The weather was bad yesterday, so we did not have a very good time.
items.why: The negative 不太 stays on the adjective after 得: 玩得不太开心. Placing 不 before 玩 would negate the verb itself.

items.zh: 下雪了，孩子们高兴得不得了。
items.py: xià xuě le hái zi men gāo xīng de bù dé liǎo
items.en: It snowed, and the children are overjoyed.
items.why: 不得了 follows an adjective through 得: 高兴得不得了. Without 得, 不得了 cannot attach.

items.zh: 她唱歌唱得非常好听。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de fēi cháng hǎo tīng
items.en: She sings very beautifully.
items.why: 唱歌 is verb + object, so 唱 is repeated before 得: 唱歌唱得非常好听. The 得 must stay on the second 唱.

items.zh: 他着急地给朋友打电话。
items.py: tā zháo jí de gěi péng you dǎ diàn huà
items.en: He anxiously phoned his friend.
items.why: 着急地 describes the manner in which he phoned, so it comes before 打电话. A comment after the verb would need 得 instead.

items.zh: 小李饺子包得很好。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ jiǎo zi bāo de hěn hǎo
items.en: Xiao Li wraps dumplings very well.
items.why: The object 饺子 moves in front of 包, and 得很好 follows the verb. Subject and object can swap places at the start.

items.src: 我朋友做菜做得很好吃。
items.src_py: wǒ péng you zuò cài zuò de hěn hǎo chī
items.task: Move the object before the verb instead of repeating it.
items.zh: 我朋友菜做得很好吃。
items.py: wǒ péng you cài zuò de hěn hǎo chī
items.en: My friend cooks really well.
items.why: The object 菜 jumps in front of 做, so the repeated verb disappears. 菜 may also start the sentence, but nothing may follow the adjective.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān shuì de hěn hǎo
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他昨天睡得不好。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: He did not sleep well yesterday.
items.why: To negate the comment, replace 很好 with 不好 after 得. The past time does not allow 没 before 睡.

items.src_py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say he does not dance well.
items.zh: 他跳舞跳得不好。
items.py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de bù hǎo
items.en: He does not dance well.
items.why: Negate only the adjective: 跳舞跳得不好. 不 before 跳 or 没 would negate the dancing itself and break the pattern.

items.src_py: nǐ men zuó tiān wán de hěn kāi xīn
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.zh: 你们昨天玩得开心不开心？
items.py: nǐ men zuó tiān wán de kāi xīn bù kāi xīn
items.en: Did you have fun yesterday?
items.why: The A-not-A is built on the adjective: 开心不开心. The 很 disappears, and 吗 is not added.

items.src_py: péng you yào lái wǒ hěn gāo xīng
items.task: Say you are extremely happy using 得不得了.
items.zh: 朋友要来，我高兴得不得了。
items.py: péng you yào lái wǒ gāo xīng de bù dé liǎo
items.en: My friend is coming, and I am overjoyed.
items.why: The degree word 很 is replaced by 得不得了 after the adjective: 高兴得不得了. 很 cannot be kept in front.

items.src_py: tā xiào de hěn kāi xīn
items.task: Say he smiled happily, with the manner before the verb.
items.zh: 他开心地笑了。
items.py: tā kāi xīn de xiào le
items.en: He smiled happily.
items.why: 开心地 stands before the verb and describes the manner of smiling; the comment 得很开心 after the verb is replaced by 地 before it.

items.src_py: tā rèn zhēn de tīng péng you shuō huà
items.task: Say how attentively she listened, with 得 after the verb.
items.zh: 她听朋友说话听得很认真。
items.py: tā tīng péng you shuō huà tīng de hěn rèn zhēn
items.en: She listens to her friends very attentively.
items.why: To comment on how she listened, repeat 听 after the object phrase and attach 得: 听朋友说话听得很认真. The 地 goes away with the move.

items.s_py: zuó tiān de xuě xià le de hěn dà
items.zh: 昨天的雪下得很大。
items.py: zuó tiān de xuě xià de hěn dà
items.en: The snow was heavy yesterday.
items.why: Nothing may sit between 下 and 得, not even 了. 昨天 already shows the past, so 下得很大 is right.

items.s: 昨晚太吵了，我没睡得好。
items.s_py: zuó wǎn tài chǎo le wǒ méi shuì de hǎo
items.zh: 昨晚太吵了，我睡得不好。
items.py: zuó wǎn tài chǎo le wǒ shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: It was too noisy last night, so I did not sleep well.
items.why: The negative belongs after 得: 睡得不好. 没 before the verb cannot combine with 得, even in the past.

items.s_py: péng you men bù wán de kāi xīn
items.zh: 朋友们玩得不开心。
items.py: péng you men wán de bù kāi xīn
items.en: My friends did not have a good time.
items.why: 不 negates the comment, so it sits after 得 on the adjective: 玩得不开心. 不玩得开心 is not Chinese.

items.s: 你觉得他中文说得很好不好？
items.s_py: nǐ jué de tā zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo bù hǎo
items.zh: 你觉得他中文说得好不好？
items.py: nǐ jué de tā zhōng wén shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Do you think he speaks Chinese well?
items.why: Inside an A-not-A question the adjective is bare: 好不好. 很 cannot stay.

items.s: 他听说朋友要来，高兴不得了。
items.s_py: tā tīng shuō péng you yào lái gāo xīng bù dé liǎo
items.zh: 他听说朋友要来，高兴得不得了。
items.py: tā tīng shuō péng you yào lái gāo xīng de bù dé liǎo
items.en: When he heard his friend was coming he was overjoyed.
items.why: 不得了 needs 得 after the adjective: 高兴得不得了. Dropping 得 is the typical error.

items.s: 他说地很清楚，朋友们都听懂了。
items.s_py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu péng you men dōu tīng dǒng le
items.zh: 他说得很清楚，朋友们都听懂了。
items.py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu péng you men dōu tīng dǒng le
items.en: He spoke very clearly, and his friends all understood.
items.why: A comment after the verb takes 得, not 地. 地 only marks a manner word before a verb.

items.s: 我朋友很漂亮写字，大家都喜欢看。
items.s_py: wǒ péng you hěn piào liang xiě zì dà jiā dōu xǐ huan kàn
items.zh: 我朋友写字写得很漂亮，大家都喜欢看。
items.py: wǒ péng you xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang dà jiā dōu xǐ huan kàn
items.en: My friend writes beautifully, and everyone likes to look at it.
items.why: In Chinese the verb comes first and the adjective follows 得: 写字写得很漂亮. English-style adjective-before-verb is wrong.

items.s: 他来地很早，朋友们还没到。
items.s_py: tā lái de hěn zǎo péng you men hái méi dào
items.zh: 他来得很早，朋友们还没到。
items.py: tā lái de hěn zǎo péng you men hái méi dào
items.en: He came early, and his friends have not arrived yet.
items.why: Timing like 很早 is a comment after the verb, linked by 得. 地 only marks a manner word before a verb, so 来地很早 is wrong.

items.s: 我弟弟踢得很好足球，朋友们都想和他一组。
items.s_py: wǒ dì di tī de hěn hǎo zú qiú péng you men dōu xiǎng hé tā yī zǔ
items.zh: 我弟弟足球踢得很好，朋友们都想和他一组。
items.py: wǒ dì di zú qiú tī de hěn hǎo péng you men dōu xiǎng hé tā yī zǔ
items.en: My little brother plays football very well, and his friends all want to be on his team.
items.why: The object 足球 cannot follow the comment. Move it before the verb: 足球踢得很好.

items.s: 昨天的雨下得不大，我们还是去爬山了。
items.zh: 昨天的雨下得不大，我们还是去爬山了。
items.py: zuó tiān de yǔ xià de bù dà wǒ men hái shì qù pá shān le
items.en: Yesterday’s rain was not heavy, so we still went hiking.
items.why: Correct: 不 follows 得. The past time does not call for 没, which tempts learners to reject it.

items.s: 他踢足球踢得好，但是游泳游得不好。
items.zh: 他踢足球踢得好，但是游泳游得不好。
items.py: tā tī zú qiú tī de hǎo dàn shì yóu yǒng yóu de bù hǎo
items.en: He plays football well, but he does not swim well.
items.why: Correct. A bare adjective after 得 is fine in a contrast, and both verb-object phrases repeat their verb before 得.

items.s: 冬天的太阳落得很早，下午五点天就黑了。
items.zh: 冬天的太阳落得很早，下午五点天就黑了。
items.py: dōng tiān de tài yang luò de hěn zǎo xià wǔ wǔ diǎn tiān jiù hēi le
items.en: In winter the sun sets very early; it is dark by five in the afternoon.
items.why: Correct: how early the sun sets is a comment after the verb 落, linked by 得. There is no 了 between them.

items.s: 你们昨天的聚会开得怎么样？
items.zh: 你们昨天的聚会开得怎么样？
items.py: nǐ men zuó tiān de jù huì kāi de zěn me yàng
items.en: How was your party yesterday?
items.why: Correct: 怎么样 follows 得 and needs no 吗. The past time does not change anything.

items.s: 他今天的心情好得很，一直在笑。
items.zh: 他今天的心情好得很，一直在笑。
items.py: tā jīn tiān de xīn qíng hǎo de hěn yī zhí zài xiào
items.en: He is in a really good mood today and keeps smiling.
items.why: Correct: adjective + 得很, with no 很 in front.

items.s: 今年夏天热极了，晚上也睡不着。
items.zh: 今年夏天热极了，晚上也睡不着。
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān rè jí le wǎn shàng yě shuì bù zháo
items.en: This summer is extremely hot, and I cannot sleep at night either.
items.why: Correct: 极了 attaches directly with no 得, which tempts learners to add 得.

items.s: 她高兴地对朋友说：“周末我请客！”
items.zh: 她高兴地对朋友说：“周末我请客！”
items.py: tā gāo xīng de duì péng you shuō zhōu mò wǒ qǐng kè
items.en: She said happily to her friends, “It is my treat this weekend!”
items.why: Correct: 高兴 describes how she spoke and stands before the verb, so 地 is right. 得 would be wrong here.

items.s: 他跑步很快，朋友们都比不过他。
items.zh: 他跑步很快，朋友们都比不过他。
items.py: tā pǎo bù hěn kuài péng you men dōu bǐ bù guò tā
items.en: He is fast at running, and none of his friends can beat him.
items.why: Correct: an activity as topic plus 很 + adjective is accepted in Chinese. It need not take 得.

items.s: 她做饭做得不太好，所以朋友们带来了蛋糕。
items.zh: 她做饭做得不太好，所以朋友们带来了蛋糕。
items.py: tā zuò fàn zuò de bù tài hǎo suǒ yǐ péng you men dài lái le dàn gāo
items.en: She does not cook very well, so her friends brought a cake.
items.why: Correct: the verb 做 is repeated, 得 follows it, and 不太 sits on the adjective.
